fields.features_heading: What a Blank Question List Leaves to the Caller
fields.features_subheading: The forms that rank give you questions and blank lines. These six pieces make every call comparable and act on the answers.
fields.feature_1:
A 1-5 rating under every question

Each work area, such as reliability or judgment, gets a 1-5 rating beside a notes box. The numbers let you compare references at a glance, and the notes keep the reasons.
fields.feature_2:
A reference list the candidate fills in

The candidate enters each reference's name, relationship, email, and years worked together, then types a signature agreeing to the calls. No one copies details off a resume.
fields.feature_3:
One question per screen

A former manager opens the emailed link and sees one question at a time. Answering takes a few taps between meetings, with no account to create and no file to send back.
fields.feature_4:
Alerts on answers that need a person

Pick the answers that should reach someone at once, such as a no on rehire or any rating of 1. The app sends that reference's answers to the hiring manager by email or Slack.
fields.feature_5:
One summary page per finalist

Every reference's ratings for a finalist line up in columns, with an average for each work area. A committee reads one page before it votes, instead of passing notes around.
fields.feature_6:
Answers in a database you own

Each rating and note saves to a database you own, filed under the candidate's name. If that person applies for another opening next year, the earlier references are on file.

fields.tab_content_1:
Each finalist signs off on three names before any call

Harrow Point Logistics sends the form to each dispatch supervisor finalist after the last interview. A finalist enters 3 references with the relationship and how long each has known them. Odessa Varga's list came in with her typed signature agreeing to the calls, and the recruiter can start dialing.
fields.tab_content_2:
Silence for two days sends the reference a reminder

Caregivers at Ashgrove Home Care list 3 references each, and every reference gets an emailed link. On a phone, the reference rates 5 work areas and answers the rehire question. For candidate Wren Adebayo, 2 of 3 references have answered. Teodor Brandt has not replied in 2 days and got a reminder this morning.
fields.tab_content_3:
A no on rehire lands in the hiring manager's inbox

Every call at Orchid Lane Dental runs on the same 8 questions in the same order, with a notes box under each. The recruiter types while the reference talks. When a reference for office manager candidate Mateo Sorensen answers no to the rehire question, hiring manager Sana Whitfield gets an email with that call's notes.
fields.tab_content_4:
With three references in, teamwork averages 3.7

A volunteer search committee at the Westbrook Literacy Project is hiring a finance director. For finalist Rafael Lindqvist, the app lines up 3 references' ratings across 5 work areas and averages each area. Teamwork comes in lowest at 3.7, and the chair raises it in the final interview before the board votes.

fields.howto_title: How to Build a Reference Check Form
fields.howto_description: Follow these 7 steps to build a reference check form that scores every reference on the same scale.
fields.howto_step_1_des: Let each finalist know you will contact their references, and collect the list at the same time. One university's HR guide reminds managers to give candidates advance notice that references will be checked.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Draft the questions once and use them for every finalist. The same guide says to ask the same questions about all final candidates and weigh the answers equally. Have your HR or legal team review the list before the first call.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Ask how the reference knows the candidate and for how long. Record whether they managed the candidate or worked beside them, because a peer's 4 and a manager's 4 rest on different views of the work.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Pick 4 to 6 work areas that matter for the role, such as accuracy or teamwork. Write one line on what a 1 and a 5 look like in each, and two callers will score the same answer the same way.
fields.howto_step_5_title: 05 Save the rehire question for last
fields.howto_step_5_des: Close with whether the reference would rehire the candidate. Then ask one open question for anything your list missed, and give it a notes box of its own.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Offer a call or a link
fields.howto_step_6_des: Send the emailed link to references who prefer to answer in writing, and call the rest. Answers from both routes land in the same table, and the summary page counts every reference.
fields.howto_step_7_des: Ask a colleague to answer as a reference, then read the summary page the form produces. Rewrite any question that drew a one-word answer before a real reference sees it.

faq_plan.q: What is a reference check form?
faq_plan.ref: What is a reference check form?

prov.original: What is a reference check form?

faq_plan.a: A reference check form is the fixed set of questions an employer asks the people a candidate names as references, with room to record each answer. Reference check forms keep every finalist measured on the same points, and the notes stay on file with the hiring decision.

faq_plan.q: How do I create a reference check form?
faq_plan.a: Describe the role and the questions you want asked to Emergent's AI form builder. It builds the form from that prompt, along with the database behind it and a summary page for the hiring manager. Change any question later by asking for the change in plain English.

faq_plan.q: Can you provide an example of a reference check form?
faq_plan.ref: Can you provide an example of a reference check form?

prov.original: Can you provide an example of a reference check form?

faq_plan.a: Yes. The University of Northern Iowa's HR office publishes a sample that opens with "Describe how long you have known this candidate and in what capacity." Further down, it asks whether the reference would have any reservations about rehiring the candidate. Copy those questions into your own reference check form, PDF or online, and edit them to fit the role.

faq_plan.q: What should a reference check form template include?
faq_plan.a: Include the candidate's name and the role, the reference's name and title, and how the two worked together. Then add your job-related questions with a notes box and a 1-5 rating under each, the rehire question, and the caller's name and the date. Consent for a criminal or credit history search goes on a separate background check form.

faq_plan.q: Is there a free reference check form with no response limit?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Emergent is free to start, and the free tier covers building and publishing a reference check form. The forms it builds have no response caps, whether 3 references answer or 300.

faq_plan.q: How many references should a reference check form ask for?
faq_plan.hint: What is a reference check form for employment?
faq_plan.a: Ask for 3, and ask that at least one be a former direct manager. With 3 sets of ratings on the same scale, an average per work area means something, and a single low score stands out against the other two.

faq_plan.q: When should you send a reference check form to a candidate?
faq_plan.a: Send it after the final interview and before any offer goes out. Asking for references on the job application form collects names for applicants you will never call. Waiting until the shortlist means each reference you contact is tied to a real decision.

faq_plan.q: What goes on a reference check form when a reference only confirms title and dates?
faq_plan.a: Log the title and dates they confirm, and ask the candidate for one more name. An article on SHRM's site says that "HR or a department manager typically provides a limited reference, confirming the employee's position and job tenure." A former client, or a manager from an earlier job, can speak to the work itself.

faq_plan.q: Who should fill in the reference check form during the call?
faq_plan.a: The person making the call, whether that is the hiring manager or a recruiter who knows the role well enough to ask a follow-up. Typing notes during the call beats rebuilding them from memory afterward. One university's sample form tells the caller to include the position, date and names of the candidate, the reference, and the person completing the check.

faq_plan.q: Can a current employee answer a reference check form for a candidate?
faq_plan.a: Yes, when they have seen the candidate's work, and their answers go on the same form as everyone else's. If that employee also recommended the candidate for the opening, log the recommendation on the employee referral form and keep the reference call as its own step. Emergent can build both forms on the same database.

plan.angle: Six of the top 10 are HR offices' own reference forms (UCSB, UNI, Northwestern, Texas A&M, CalHR, Fairbanks North Star Borough) saved as Word files and PDFs; Indeed, SHRM and LinkedIn add question lists, and pdfFiller hosts a fillable copy. They all ask the same things: how the reference knows the candidate, the work they did, performance and rehire. None scores the answers or does anything after the call ends. This page gives the form a 1-5 rating per work area and builds what a document cannot: the candidate's own reference list with a typed signature, an emailed questionnaire with a reminder, a call script that emails the hiring manager when a reference would not rehire, and one summary per finalist with an average for each area.
